newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady with mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady with mild weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady again Wednesday with mild temperatures, including overnight lows in the mid-50s degrees Fahrenheit in southern Texas, industry sources said.
Off peak power was reported to be very difficult to sell in ERCOT with no demand for power at night, the brokers and marketers said.
On-peak firm ERCOT power for Thursday delivery was talked steady to slightly lower in the $17.80-18.80 range from $18.50-19.50 on Tuesday, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak firm next-day power was said to be offered as low as $9.00 and $11.00 per MWh with no takers.
November ERCOT power was thinly talked at $18.00-19.00, while December was said to have been discussed near $20.50.
